## Should I hire a video ad production company or make ads myself?


It depends on how many ads you need. A production company suits brands needing a steady flow, about 100 a month across AI UGC, 3D and commercials. If you have an editor and only need a few, self-serve costs less.

Pricing and guarantee **


## Video production scoped on a call.


Plans start at $5,000 a month; agree production scope and the exact price on a call.


### The plan


- Book a call for your exact plan and quote. The plan delivers roughly 100 finished ads a month in weekly batches of about 25.
- Each approved variant counts as one ad. Drafts, re-exports and minor revisions never count.
- No per-creative charges and no annual contract.
- Concept, script, production, edit, sound and render are included, plus cleared rights to the music, stock and generated content in every ad.
- You keep every finished ad. Media spend is always yours.
- One plan covers all three formats, mixed per angle.


### The guarantee


Hit the agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay.


- We agree the target in writing before launch and measure it in tracking you can audit, not Meta's dashboard.
- For an account already running ads, the target is 15% better than your current cost per result. For a new account, it is set from your margin or sales math.
- If the target is not hit after 30 days of the system running, you do not pay for the month. Media spend stays yours either way.


### Creative-only plans


A refund rather than a target, because your team runs the account.


Make more than you pay us, or you pay nothing.


- If the ads have not earned you more than you paid us in the first 90 days, cancel by email.
- We refund 100% of what you paid within 10 business days, with no deductions for work delivered.
- You keep every finished ad we made, refund or not.
- The refund is subject to the terms in the written agreement we both sign before production starts, and those terms must be met for it to apply.
